input.summary:
Ikeja Depot Shop, Drinks Chiller: audit confidence 0.76, compliance 82%, planogram share 100%, no unknown products. 9 of 11 planogram SKUs were at expected facings. Two were out:

- Coca-Cola 50cl PET (expected 3, observed 0): on_hand 0, reorder point 6, case size 12. Nothing in the store to refill with, so ordered 2 cases = 24 units (approx. N7,200) to cover 3 facings x 3 units plus the reorder point.
- Ragolis Water 75cl (expected 3, observed 0): on_hand 4, reorder point 6, case size 12. The shelf is empty but the store holds 4 units, so the immediate fix is a SHELF REFILL from back stock, not a delivery. Because on-hand (4) is still at/below the reorder point (6), also ordered 1 case = 12 units (approx. N2,400) as a top-up.

Total proposed spend approx. N9,600, both lines status "proposed". A manager was notified via WhatsApp with the refill instruction and the stock-out list. No technician dispatched: no telemetry was available for this store and the audit reported no visible equipment damage, so there is no evidence of a fridge fault - only empty facings, which do not justify a dispatch. I flagged in the notification that the manager should visually check chiller temperature since telemetry was missing.

No escalation: confidence 0.76 is acceptable, the image was a shelf, and all observed products were in the planogram.
